name: AI Content Automation for YouTube
description: An open-source AI-powered tool that automates content creation for YouTube by writing scripts, generating voiceovers, creating videos, and uploading them automatically to enable hands-free channel growth.

inputs.name: topic
inputs.description: The subject or theme for which the AI will generate content.

inputs.name: script_parameters
inputs.description: Configuration options for script generation such as tone, length, and style.

inputs.name: voiceover_settings
inputs.description: Options for voiceover creation including voice type, language, and speed.

inputs.name: video_assets
inputs.description: Media files or links used to compose the video.

inputs.name: youtube_credentials
inputs.description: Authentication data for accessing and uploading to a YouTube channel.

outputs.name: script
outputs.description: Generated script text for the video content.

outputs.name: voiceover_audio
outputs.description: AI generated voiceover audio based on the script.

outputs.name: video_file
outputs.description: Fully composed video combining script, voiceover, and visuals.

outputs.name: upload_status
outputs.description: Confirmation or error message related to the YouTube upload process.

patterns: Automated content generation with AI natural language processing
Video composition from script, audio, and visual assets
Automated social media API integration for upload
End-to-end pipeline orchestration for content creation
steps: Receive topic and configuration inputs from user
Generate video script using AI text generation models
Produce voiceover audio using text-to-speech synthesis
Assemble video including visuals, scripted text, and voiceover
Automatically upload final video to YouTube using provided credentials
Provide feedback or status of upload completion
use_cases: YouTube channel creators looking to automate and scale content production
Marketers producing automated video ads or explainer videos
Educational content developers generating course videos automatically
Social media influencers creating consistent video presence with minimal manual effort

prompt_templates.name: script_generation_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Write a detailed, engaging script about {topic} in a {tone} tone of approximately {length} words.

prompt_templates.name: voiceover_customization_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Generate a voiceover for the following script using a {voice_type} voice with {language} language and {speed} speed: {script_text}

prompt_templates.name: upload_video_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Upload the video titled '{video_title}' with description '{video_description}' to the connected YouTube channel.
